Amkor Technology Reports Financial Results for the Third Quarter 2026
TEMPE, Ariz. -- October 26, 2026 -- Amkor Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMKR), a leading provider of semiconductor packaging and test services, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Third Quarter 2026 Highlights
• Net sales $1.99 billion
• Gross profit $364 million, operating income $225 million
• Net in come $191 million, earnings per diluted share $0.76
• EBITDA $435 million
“Amkor delivered a strong quarter, with record revenue in Computing and Automotive & Industrial end markets and continued margin expansion, despite expected weakness in Communications,” said Kevin Engel, Amkor’s president and chief executive officer. “We are executing on our strategy, advancing key customer programs and benefiting from expanding customer commitments that improve visibility and support disciplined investment to meet future demand.”
Quarterly Financial Results
($ in millions, except per share data)
Q3 2026 Q2 2026 Q3 2025
Net sales $1,991 $1,898 $1,987
Gross margin 18.3% 16.8% 14.3%
Operating income $225 $200 $159
Operating income margin 11.3% 10.5% 8.0%
Net income attributable to Amkor $191 $174 $127
Earnings per diluted share $0.76 $0.70 $0.51
EBITDA (1) $435 $400 $340
(1) EBITDA is a non-GAAP measure. The reconciliation to the comparable GAAP measure is included below under “Selected Operating Data.”
At September 30, 2026, total cash and short-term investments was $2.4 billion, and total debt was $2.5 billion.
The company paid a quarterly dividend of $0.08352 per share on September 22, 2026. The declaration and payment of future dividends, as well as any record and payment dates, are subject to the approval of the Board of Directors.
During the third quarter of 2026, the company purchased approximately $32 million of common stock under its stock repurchase program.
Business Outlook
The following information presents Amkor’s guidance for the fourth quarter 2026 (unless otherwise noted):
• Net sales of $1.9 billion to $2.0 billion
• Gross margin of 18.0% to 19.0%
• Net income of $160 million to $185 million, or $0.65 to $0.75 per diluted share
• Full year 2026 capital expenditures updated to approximately $2.5 billion

Conference Call Information
Amkor will conduct a conference call on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. This call may include material information not included in this press release. To access the live audio webcast and the accompanying slide presentation, visit the Investor Relations section of Amkor’s website, located at ir.amkor.com. The live call can also be accessed by dialing 1-877-407-4019 or 1-201-689-8337.
About Amkor Technology, Inc.
Amkor Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMKR) is the world’s largest U.S. headquartered OSAT and is a global leader in outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services. With a strong track record of innovation, a broad and diverse geographic footprint and solid partnerships with lead customers, Amkor delivers high-quality solutions that enable the world’s leading semiconductor and electronics companies to bring advanced technologies to market. The company’s comprehensive portfolio includes advanced packaging, wafer-level processing, and system-in-package solutions targeting applications for smartphones, data centers, artificial intelligence, automobiles and wearables. For more information visit amkor.com.

Amkor Technology Reports Financial Results for the Second Quarter 2026
TEMPE, Ariz. -- July 27, 2026 -- Amkor Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMKR), a leading provider of semiconductor packaging and test services, today announced financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Record Second Quarter 2026 Highlights
• Net sales $1.90 billion, up 26% year-on-year
• Gross profit $319 million, operating income $200 million
• Net in come $174 million, earnings per diluted share $0.70
• EBITDA $400 million
“Amkor delivered record second quarter revenue and strong profitability, with record revenue in our Computing and Automotive & Industrial end markets," said Kevin Engel, president and chief executive officer. "During the first half of 2026, we expanded strategic partnerships across the semiconductor ecosystem, advanced key customer programs in AI and HPC, and continued the expansion of our Advanced packaging and test capacity. We expect these actions will strengthen our competitive position, increase our earnings power, and create sustainable shareholder value.”

Net income and earnings per diluted share also include a $16 million and $0.07 benefit, respectively.
At June 30, 2026, total cash and short-term investments was $2.5 billion, and total debt was $2.5 billion.

• Net sales of $1.95 billion to $2.05 billion

• Full year 2026 capital expenditures of approximately $2.5 billion to $3.0 billion
